message: The other day, I was whipping up dinner when I realized I hadn’t checked our smoke alarms in a while. Just as I went to grab my phone for a quick reminder, the battery died! Talk about timing. I had to rely on good old-fashioned memory, which led me to create a little checklist on the fridge instead. It’s funny how technology can fail us in the moments we need it most. Do you have a backup plan for keeping your home safe?
